cacheVariables.$comment-compile-commands: The compile database, for the editor. Without it IntelliSense guesses the language standard and the include paths, and guesses them wrong: it reported std::span as missing from a tree that compiles, because it had defaulted to C++17 and knew nothing of vcpkg's FFmpeg.

cacheVariables.$comment-backends: Every backend this machine can build, so that the unit tests cover all of them: the libavcodec ones (QSV, VA-API, x264/x265) that consumers link, and the native oneVPL one, which needs the oneVPL SDK.
cacheVariables.$comment: Manifest mode off deliberately: this preset reuses the tree already installed in VCPKG_ROOT, which is what makes a reconfigure take a second. The manifest presets are what a fresh checkout uses.
